subject: Marine Works - Pointe-des-Monts to Anticosti - north - Sept-Îles Port
text:
Marine Works - Pointe-des-Monts to Anticosti - north - Sept-Îles Port
Seismic surveys taking place up to 500 metres east of the multi-user dock, sections 35 and 36 from 301000 UTC Sep 2026 until 142300 UTC Oct 2026. Small boats and barges on site. 
Stay clear 200 metres.
